mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.0% (current level 3.72%) consistently predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns through reduced discount rates for equity cash flows, with the signal always active regardless of absolute rate level.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5.0% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances over a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 325.0 (current level 326.03) signals persistent inflation, triggering risk-off behavior and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through central bank policy expectations.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 325.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a rolling 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 325.0 (current levels 3.72 and 326.03) indicates a 'low rate, high inflation' environment, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through imminent policy tightening.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.0 AND CPIAUCSL > 325.0 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances over a rolling 3-year window.
